summary: Build export readiness, compliance, and buyer access skills with practical tools for agricultural trade teams. Enrol now.
lede: Agricultural export standards and market access work helps trade professionals assess whether products are ready for export. Designed for people handling compliance, quality assurance, traceability or market entry, the course covers assessing products against standards, interpreting buyer requirements, organizing traceability and shipment records, and using market signals to shape a practical market-entry plan.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who handle agricultural export compliance, buyer readiness, and market entry planning across the value chain.
prerequisites: Participants should have working knowledge of agribusiness operations, produce handling, or trade administration. Prior experience with export documentation, certification processes, quality management, or buyer engagement will help, but no programming or coding is required. The course is intermediate level, so you should be comfortable reading trade documents, product specifications, and basic compliance records. A laptop is useful for working with templates, market analysis sheets, and digital traceability examples, but it is not mandatory.
